item.title: Samsung’s Z Fold 8 Ultra is more of the same, but better than ever
item.summary: What makes the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra so Ultra? Samsung's first foldable with the Ultra name isn't a souped-up version of the regular Fold 8, as you might expect.
